jp: 神の座を追われた牛人。昔は生贄を奉げることで鎮めることができたらしいが、今やモーロクしており生贄を奉げられたことにも気づかない。
jp_grezzo: "神の座を追われた牛人。昔は生贄を奉げることで鎮めることができたらしいが、今やモーロクしており生贄を奉げられたことにも気づかない。"
en: Cattlemen who have been driven from the throne of God. It is said that in the past they could be appeased by offering sacrifices, but now they are moloch and do not even realise that they have been offered sacrifices.
en_grezzo: "Cattlemen who have been driven from the throne of God. It is said that in the past they could be appeased by offering sacrifices, but now they are moloch and do not even realise that they have been offered sacrifices. "
it: Un uomo toro cacciato dal trono divino. Pare che un tempo lo si potesse placare offrendogli un sacrificio, ma ormai è tanto rimbambito che non si accorge nemmeno di averne ricevuto uno.

jp: てんとう虫という古代昆虫の遺伝子を内包しており、太陽に向かって飛ぶことから天の道を行くとされる。強敵には加速能力で対抗する。
jp_grezzo: "てんとう虫という古代昆虫の遺伝子を内包しており、太陽に向かって飛ぶことから天の道を行くとされる。強敵には加速能力で対抗する。"
en: It has internalised the genes of an ancient insect called a Tendou beetle and is considered to be on the path of heaven as it flies towards the sun. It uses its acceleration ability against strong enemies.
en_grezzo: "It has internalised the genes of an ancient insect called a Tendou beetle and is considered to be on the path of heaven as it flies towards the sun. It uses its acceleration ability against strong enemies. "
it: Racchiude in sé i geni di un insetto antico, la coccinella, e poiché vola verso il sole si dice che percorra la via del cielo. Ai nemici forti risponde con la sua capacità di accelerare.

jp: ネフィアを守る巨大なエント。世界樹の遺伝子はネフィアを持つ大樹と同じであるため、成長しきると人とは比べ物にならないほどの大きさを誇るのではと言われている。
jp_grezzo: "ネフィアを守る巨大なエント。世界樹の遺伝子はネフィアを持つ大樹と同じであるため、成長しきると人とは比べ物にならないほどの大きさを誇るのではと言われている。"
en: It has internalised the genes of an ancient insect called a Tendou beetle, and is considered to be on the path of heaven as it flies towards the sun. It uses its acceleration ability against strong enemies.
en_grezzo: "It has internalised the genes of an ancient insect called a Tendou beetle, and is considered to be on the path of heaven as it flies towards the sun. It uses its acceleration ability against strong enemies. "
it: Un ent gigantesco che fa la guardia alle Nefia. I geni dell'albero del mondo sono gli stessi del grande albero che porta in sé una Nefia, e per questo si dice che, una volta cresciuto del tutto, vanti una mole che con l'uomo non ha proprio confronto.

jp: 破壊と再生を表す錬金術のシンボル。再生能力が非常に高い。お腹がすくと自分の尻尾に噛みついてグルグル回りだす習性があるが意味はあるのだろうか。
jp_grezzo: "破壊と再生を表す錬金術のシンボル。再生能力が非常に高い。お腹がすくと自分の尻尾に噛みついてグルグル回りだす習性があるが意味はあるのだろうか。"
en: Alchemical symbol for destruction and regeneration. It has a very high capacity for regeneration. When hungry, it has the habit of biting its own tail and starting to spin round and round, but what does this mean?
en_grezzo: "Alchemical symbol for destruction and regeneration. It has a very high capacity for regeneration. When hungry, it has the habit of biting its own tail and starting to spin round and round, but what does this mean?"
it: Il simbolo alchemico della distruzione e della rigenerazione. La sua capacità di rigenerarsi è altissima. Quando ha fame prende l'abitudine di mordersi la coda e di girare in tondo, ma un senso ce l'avrà?

jp: 独自の進化を続け竜に遜色のない力を手に入れた亜種。だがその名には『半分蜥蜴』との意味が隠されており、どれだけ強くなっても竜になれなかったことを示している。
jp_grezzo: "独自の進化を続け竜に遜色のない力を手に入れた亜種。だがその名には『半分蜥蜴』との意味が隠されており、どれだけ強くなっても竜になれなかったことを示している。"
en: A subspecies that has continued to evolve in its own way and has acquired a power comparable to that of a dragon. However, hidden in its name is the meaning 'half lizard', indicating that it could not become a dragon no matter how strong it became.
en_grezzo: "A subspecies that has continued to evolve in its own way and has acquired a power comparable to that of a dragon. However, hidden in its name is the meaning 'half lizard', indicating that it could not become a dragon no matter how strong it became. "
it: Una sottospecie che ha continuato a evolversi per conto suo fino a ottenere una forza che davanti a un drago non sfigura. Ma nel suo nome si nasconde il significato di mezza lucertola, e dice che per quanto sia diventato forte drago non è mai riuscito a diventarlo.

jp: 人の擬態を好む悪魔の一種。艶めかしい女性の姿で人に近づき弄ぶ。不意打ちで殺すか、異物を寄生させるか、遊び方は気分次第で決めるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "人の擬態を好む悪魔の一種。艶めかしい女性の姿で人に近づき弄ぶ。不意打ちで殺すか、異物を寄生させるか、遊び方は気分次第で決めるらしい。"
en: A type of demon that likes to mimic people. It approaches people in the form of a glamorous woman and plays with them. It is said to decide how to play, whether to kill by surprise or to parasitize with a miasma, depending on its mood.
en_grezzo: "A type of demon that likes to mimic people. It approaches people in the form of a glamorous woman and plays with them. It is said to decide how to play, whether to kill by surprise or to parasitize with a miasma, depending on its mood."
it: Una specie di demone a cui piace prendere le sembianze degli uomini. Si avvicina alla gente nella figura di una donna procace e ci gioca. Se ucciderla di sorpresa o farle annidare dentro un corpo estraneo, pare che lo decida secondo l'umore.

jp: 何処かに封印されているという黒き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝している者。ぽっかりと刳り抜かれた眼窩より、囚われた心の悲鳴が聞こえる。
jp_grezzo: "何処かに封印されているという黒き悪魔に心を奪われ崇拝している者。ぽっかりと刳り抜かれた眼窩より、囚われた心の悲鳴が聞こえる。"
en: A person who is enthralled by and worships a black demon that is said to be sealed somewhere. From the gouged-out eye sockets, the screams of a trapped heart can be heard.
en_grezzo: "A person who is enthralled by and worships a black demon that is said to be sealed somewhere. From the gouged-out eye sockets, the screams of a trapped heart can be heard. "
it: Uno a cui il demone nero, che si dice sigillato da qualche parte, ha rapito il cuore, e che adesso lo adora. Dalle orbite scavate e vuote si sente il grido del cuore prigioniero.

jp: 妄執と所有欲と独占欲から成る愛に毒されてしまったキューピッド。重く歪んだ愛の矢は射抜かれた者の心を蝕み、破壊する。
jp_grezzo: "妄執と所有欲と独占欲から成る愛に毒されてしまったキューピッド。重く歪んだ愛の矢は射抜かれた者の心を蝕み、破壊する。"
en: Cupid has been poisoned by the love that consists of delusion, possessiveness and proprietary desire. The heavy, distorted arrows of love corrode and destroy the hearts of those who are shot through them.
en_grezzo: "Cupid has been poisoned by the love that consists of delusion, possessiveness and proprietary desire. The heavy, distorted arrows of love corrode and destroy the hearts of those who are shot through them. "
it: Un cupido avvelenato da un amore fatto di ossessione, di possesso e di gelosia. Le sue frecce d'amore, pesanti e storte, corrodono e distruggono il cuore di chi trafiggono.

jp: 雷と共に突然現れる謎のファントム。内部に貯め込まれたエネルギーは本体が傷つくと暴走を起こし、大爆発の原因となる。火炎砲を装備。
jp_grezzo: "雷と共に突然現れる謎のファントム。内部に貯め込まれたエネルギーは本体が傷つくと暴走を起こし、大爆発の原因となる。火炎砲を装備。"
en: A mysterious phantom that suddenly appears with lightning. The energy stored inside causes a runaway when the main body is damaged, resulting in a huge explosion. Equipped with a flame cannon.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious phantom that suddenly appears with lightning. The energy stored inside causes a runaway when the main body is damaged, resulting in a huge explosion. Equipped with a flame cannon."
it: Un fantasma misterioso che compare all'improvviso insieme al fulmine. L'energia che tiene dentro, se il corpo si danneggia, si scatena senza controllo e provoca una grande esplosione. È armato di un cannone a fiamma.

jp: 鋭く発達した前歯を持つウサギ。その歯による攻撃はとても鋭く、一撃で頚動脈をかき切る。見た目はただの可愛らしいウサギだが、舐めてかかろうものなら敗北必至。
jp_grezzo: "鋭く発達した前歯を持つウサギ。その歯による攻撃はとても鋭く、一撃で頚動脈をかき切る。見た目はただの可愛らしいウサギだが、舐めてかかろうものなら敗北必至。"
en: A rabbit with sharply developed front teeth. Its teeth are so sharp that a single blow can cut through the carotid artery of an Indian Elephant. It may look like just a cute rabbit, but if you try to take advantage of it, you will inevitably lose.
en_grezzo: "A rabbit with sharply developed front teeth. Its teeth are so sharp that a single blow can cut through the carotid artery of an Indian Elephant. It may look like just a cute rabbit, but if you try to take advantage of it, you will inevitably lose."
it: Un coniglio dagli incisivi lunghi e affilati. L'attacco di quei denti taglia da fare paura: recide la carotide in un colpo solo. A vederlo è soltanto un coniglietto grazioso, ma chi lo prende sottogamba le prende di sicuro.

jp: 餌や生息地域が被るドラゴン種族との生存競争に勝つため、対抗してブレスを放つ力を身に着けた。スピードとパワーも上がっており、ドラゴンを圧倒する。
jp_grezzo: "餌や生息地域が被るドラゴン種族との生存競争に勝つため、対抗してブレスを放つ力を身に着けた。スピードとパワーも上がっており、ドラゴンを圧倒する。"
en: In order to compete for survival with dragon races that share their food and habitat, they have acquired the ability to release their breath in opposition. Their speed and power have also increased, making them overwhelming to dragons.
en_grezzo: "In order to compete for survival with dragon races that share their food and habitat, they have acquired the ability to release their breath in opposition. Their speed and power have also increased, making them overwhelming to dragons. "
it: Per vincere la lotta per la vita con le stirpi dei draghi, che gli contendono il cibo e il territorio, ha imparato a rispondere lanciando il soffio. Sono cresciute anche la velocità e la potenza, e ormai i draghi li travolge.

jp: 蜘蛛の神の分体。その本体は広大な深淵に幽閉されており、今も一心不乱に巣を作り続けているとされる。真相は不明だが、巣が完全に完成すると終末が訪れるという説がある。
jp_grezzo: "蜘蛛の神の分体。その本体は広大な深淵に幽閉されており、今も一心不乱に巣を作り続けているとされる。真相は不明だが、巣が完全に完成すると終末が訪れるという説がある。"
en: An incarnation of the spider god. The main body is said to be imprisoned in a vast abyss, where it continues to build its web with single-minded devotion. The truth is unknown, but there is a theory that the apocalypse will come when the web is fully completed.
en_grezzo: "An incarnation of the spider god. The main body is said to be imprisoned in a vast abyss, where it continues to build its web with single-minded devotion. The truth is unknown, but there is a theory that the apocalypse will come when the web is fully completed."
it: Una parte staccata dal dio ragno. Il corpo vero è rinchiuso in un abisso sterminato, dove si dice continui a tessere la tela senza distrarsi un attimo. Come stiano le cose non si sa, ma c'è chi sostiene che quando la tela sarà finita arriverà la fine del mondo.

jp: エーテルを好む、偉大なる竜の上位種。巨体から繰り出される打撃は単純だが極めて強力であり、もはやブレスなどを必要としない。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、偉大なる竜の上位種。巨体から繰り出される打撃は単純だが極めて強力であり、もはやブレスなどを必要としない。"
en: A higher form of the great dragons, with a preference for the ether wind. The blows delivered from its huge body are simple but extremely powerful and they no longer require breath.
en_grezzo: "A higher form of the great dragons, with a preference for the ether wind. The blows delivered from its huge body are simple but extremely powerful and they no longer require breath. "
it: La specie superiore dei grandi draghi, e ha un debole per l'etere. I colpi che sferra con quel corpo enorme sono semplici ma di una potenza estrema, e ormai del soffio non ha più bisogno.

jp: 賞金首を狩ることで生計を立てている。商人が集まる街では盗賊が出没しやすいため、それを狩りに来たハンターがそのまま定住することが多い。
jp_grezzo: "賞金首を狩ることで生計を立てている。商人が集まる街では盗賊が出没しやすいため、それを狩りに来たハンターがそのまま定住することが多い。"
en: They make a living by pursuing bounties. As bandits are more likely to appear in towns where merchants congregate, hunters who come to hunt them often settle directly in the area.
en_grezzo: "They make a living by pursuing bounties. As bandits are more likely to appear in towns where merchants congregate, hunters who come to hunt them often settle directly in the area. "
it: Si guadagna da vivere dando la caccia a chi ha una taglia sulla testa. Nelle città dove si radunano i mercanti i ladri saltano fuori con facilità, e così i cacciatori che ci arrivano per stanarli spesso finiscono per stabilircisi.

jp: 地下世界で崇拝されている神の一柱。比較的寛容で、敬虔な信者には力を貸す事すらある。このイルヴァにおいては他の神の力が強い為、完全な形で降臨する事はできない。
jp_grezzo: "地下世界で崇拝されている神の一柱。比較的寛容で、敬虔な信者には力を貸す事すらある。このイルヴァにおいては他の神の力が強い為、完全な形で降臨する事はできない。"
en: One of the gods worshipped in the underworld. He is relatively tolerant and even lends his power to pious believers. Because of the strength of other deities in this Irva, he is unable to descend in full form.
en_grezzo: "One of the gods worshipped in the underworld. He is relatively tolerant and even lends his power to pious believers. Because of the strength of other deities in this Irva, he is unable to descend in full form."
it: Una delle divinità venerate nel mondo sotterraneo. È piuttosto tollerante, e ai fedeli devoti presta perfino la sua forza. Qui in Irva la forza delle altre divinità è grande, e per questo non riesce a discendere nella sua forma piena.

jp: 無貌にして千の貌を持った強壮なる神性。混沌をこそ何よりも貴び、狂気と混乱を撒き散らし、人々を破滅へと導く存在。面白半分で場をひっかき回すタイプ。
jp_grezzo: "無貌にして千の貌を持った強壮なる神性。混沌をこそ何よりも貴び、狂気と混乱を撒き散らし、人々を破滅へと導く存在。面白半分で場をひっかき回すタイプ。"
en: A mighty divinity with a thousand faces and no face. He is the kind of person who treasures chaos above all else, spreads madness and confusion, and leads people to their doom. He is the type of person who spread misinformation just for the fun of it.
en_grezzo: "A mighty divinity with a thousand faces and no face. He is the kind of person who treasures chaos above all else, spreads madness and confusion, and leads people to their doom. He is the type of person who spread misinformation just for the fun of it."
it: Una divinità possente, senza volto e insieme con mille volti. Sopra ogni cosa tiene al caos: sparge follia e confusione e conduce gli uomini alla rovina. È il tipo che mette scompiglio per mezzo divertimento.

jp: シュブ=ニグラスの夫にして風を司る異界の神性。イルヴァ土着の風神の妨害により完全な降臨が出来ず手をこまねいている。
jp_grezzo: "シュブ=ニグラスの夫にして風を司る異界の神性。イルヴァ土着の風神の妨害により完全な降臨が出来ず手をこまねいている。"
en: Husband of Shub-Niggurath, divinity of the other world who governs the wind. He has been unable to descend fully due to the interference of the indigenous Irva wind goddess.
en_grezzo: "Husband of Shub-Niggurath, divinity of the other world who governs the wind. He has been unable to descend fully due to the interference of the indigenous Irva wind goddess. "
it: Marito di Shub-Niggurath, divinità di un altro mondo che governa il vento. La dea del vento nativa di Irva gli ostacola la strada, e così non riesce a discendere del tutto e resta con le mani in mano.

jp: たけのこ族の生き残り。きのこ族の山を滅ぼそうとしているが里から出たことがなかったため、胞子で増えたきのこ族がティリス地方全体へと広がっている事実を知らない。
jp_grezzo: "たけのこ族の生き残り。きのこ族の山を滅ぼそうとしているが里から出たことがなかったため、胞子で増えたきのこ族がティリス地方全体へと広がっている事実を知らない。"
en: Remnants of the Bamboo Tribe. They are trying to destroy the Mushroom Tribe's villages, but as they have never left their villages, they are unaware of the fact that the Mushroom Tribe, which has increased through spores, has spread all over the Tyris region.
en_grezzo: "Remnants of the Bamboo Tribe. They are trying to destroy the Mushroom Tribe's villages, but as they have never left their villages, they are unaware of the fact that the Mushroom Tribe, which has increased through spores, has spread all over the Tyris region. "
it: Il superstite della gente dei germogli di bambù. Vuole distruggere la montagna della gente dei funghi, ma dal suo villaggio non è mai uscito, e non sa che i funghi, moltiplicandosi con le spore, si sono ormai sparsi per tutta la regione di Tyris.

jp: 獣類の長とされる幻獣で、限りなく神に近い存在。根は温厚だが、敵対する相手には容赦無く襲い掛かる。好きな飲み物はビアだというが本当だろうか。
jp_grezzo: "獣類の長とされる幻獣で、限りなく神に近い存在。根は温厚だが、敵対する相手には容赦無く襲い掛かる。好きな飲み物はビアだというが本当だろうか。"
en: infinitely close to being a god. They are mild-mannered at heart, but will attack their opponents mercilessly. Their favourite drink is beer, but is that really true?
en_grezzo: "infinitely close to being a god. They are mild-mannered at heart, but will attack their opponents mercilessly. Their favourite drink is beer, but is that really true?"
it: Una bestia fantastica ritenuta il capo degli animali, e vicina a un dio quanto più si può. In fondo è mite, ma su chi gli si oppone piomba senza pietà. Dicono che la sua bevanda preferita sia la birra: sarà vero?

jp: 首と足がとてつもなく長い奇妙な獣。子供たちに大人気だが、鼻が長くて耳が大きい動物には負けるらしい。また、同名の幻獣が存在する。
jp_grezzo: "首と足がとてつもなく長い奇妙な獣。子供たちに大人気だが、鼻が長くて耳が大きい動物には負けるらしい。また、同名の幻獣が存在する。"
en: A strange beast with an incredibly long neck and legs. It is very popular with children, but is said to be defeated by animals with long noses and large ears. There is also a phantom beast of the same name.
en_grezzo: "A strange beast with an incredibly long neck and legs. It is very popular with children, but is said to be defeated by animals with long noses and large ears. There is also a phantom beast of the same name."
it: Una bestia strana, dal collo e dalle zampe lunghissimi. Piace moltissimo ai bambini, ma pare che perda il confronto con l'animale dal naso lungo e dalle orecchie grandi. Ed esiste anche una bestia fantastica che porta lo stesso nome.

jp: 殺戮衝動に支配された騎士の魂が鎧に宿ったもの。血を見ることで落ち着く危ないやつ。生身だったころの名前をまだ思い出せないことを気にしている。
jp_grezzo: "殺戮衝動に支配された騎士の魂が鎧に宿ったもの。血を見ることで落ち着く危ないやつ。生身だったころの名前をまだ思い出せないことを気にしている。"
en: The soul of a knight, controlled by the urge to kill, is dwelling in his armour. A dangerous one who is calmed by the sight of blood. He is concerned that he still cannot remember his name when he was alive.
en_grezzo: "The soul of a knight, controlled by the urge to kill, is dwelling in his armour. A dangerous one who is calmed by the sight of blood. He is concerned that he still cannot remember his name when he was alive."
it: L'anima di un cavaliere dominata dall'impulso di uccidere, annidata dentro la sua armatura. Un tipo pericoloso, che si calma soltanto alla vista del sangue. Gli pesa non riuscire ancora a ricordare il nome che portava da vivo.

jp: 年を経た虎が変異した。蒼い月光の下で咆哮するその姿にはどこかもの悲しさを感じる。詩を聞くと、わけもわからず涙を流す。
jp_grezzo: "年を経た虎が変異した。蒼い月光の下で咆哮するその姿にはどこかもの悲しさを感じる。詩を聞くと、わけもわからず涙を流す。"
en: An age-old tiger has mutated. Its roar under the blue moonlight is somehow sad. When he hears poetry, he weeps without knowing why.
en_grezzo: "An age-old tiger has mutated. Its roar under the blue moonlight is somehow sad. When he hears poetry, he weeps without knowing why."
it: È una tigre molto vecchia che è mutata. Nel suo ruggito sotto la luna azzurra c'è qualcosa di malinconico. Quando sente una poesia piange, e non sa nemmeno perché.

jp: 戦いの果てにかたつむりと和解した清掃員。かたつむりとの長い修行を経て、人間としては破格の戦闘力を身に着けた。
jp_grezzo: "戦いの果てにかたつむりと和解した清掃員。かたつむりとの長い修行を経て、人間としては破格の戦闘力を身に着けた。"
en: A cleaner who reconciled with a snail at the end of a battle. Through her long years of training with the snail, she has developed unparalleled fighting skills as a human.
en_grezzo: "A cleaner who reconciled with a snail at the end of a battle. Through her long years of training with the snail, she has developed unparalleled fighting skills as a human. "
it: Uno spazzino che alla fine di una battaglia ha fatto pace con una lumaca. Dopo un lungo allenamento insieme alla lumaca ha acquistato una potenza di combattimento fuori misura per un essere umano.

jp: アンドロイドに乗ったかたつむり。機械のマニと仲がいい。耐塩防御は完璧で、投げつけられた塩を無効化するシステムをアンドロイドが搭載している。
jp_grezzo: "アンドロイドに乗ったかたつむり。機械のマニと仲がいい。耐塩防御は完璧で、投げつけられた塩を無効化するシステムをアンドロイドが搭載している。"
en: Snail on a android. Close friends with the machine god Mani. His salt-resist defences are perfect and the android is equipped with a system that nullifies salt thrown at it.
en_grezzo: "Snail on a android. Close friends with the machine god Mani. His salt-resist defences are perfect and the android is equipped with a system that nullifies salt thrown at it."
it: Una lumaca in sella a un androide. Va d'accordo con Mani della Macchina. La sua difesa contro il sale è perfetta: l'androide monta un sistema che annulla il sale che gli tirano addosso.

jp: 金持ちながらも嫌味なところがない温厚な男性だったが、ある日を境に狂ったかのような言動を繰り返すようになった。原因はいまだ不明。
jp_grezzo: "金持ちながらも嫌味なところがない温厚な男性だったが、ある日を境に狂ったかのような言動を繰り返すようになった。原因はいまだ不明。"
en: He was a rich but mild-mannered man with no sarcasm, but one day he began to speak and behave as if he had gone mad. The cause is still unknown.
en_grezzo: "He was a rich but mild-mannered man with no sarcasm, but one day he began to speak and behave as if he had gone mad. The cause is still unknown. "
it: Era un uomo mite, ricco ma senza niente di antipatico, poi da un certo giorno in poi ha cominciato a dire e a fare cose da pazzo. La causa non si è ancora capita.

jp: 混沌の意志の介入により力が増幅されたオルフェ。更なる力と新たな混沌の剣を手にし、下級眷属を使役する能力にも目覚めた。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の意志の介入により力が増幅されたオルフェ。更なる力と新たな混沌の剣を手にし、下級眷属を使役する能力にも目覚めた。"
en: Orphe whose power has been amplified by the intervention of the Will of Chaos. He gained further power and a new sword of chaos, and also awakened his ability to use his lower level servants.
en_grezzo: "Orphe whose power has been amplified by the intervention of the Will of Chaos. He gained further power and a new sword of chaos, and also awakened his ability to use his lower level servants. "
it: Orphe, la cui forza è stata amplificata dall'intervento della volontà del caos. Ha ottenuto altro potere e una nuova spada del caos, e in lui si è svegliata anche la capacità di comandare i figli del caos di rango inferiore.

jp: 見た目こそただの巨大な柴犬だが、世界の終わりが近づいたときには真の力を発揮し、再生のために世界を破壊すると言われている。
jp_grezzo: "見た目こそただの巨大な柴犬だが、世界の終わりが近づいたときには真の力を発揮し、再生のために世界を破壊すると言われている。"
en: Although they look like just giant Shiba Inu, it is said that when the end of the world is near, they will show their true power and destroy the world in order to regenerate it.
en_grezzo: "Although they look like just giant Shiba Inu, it is said that when the end of the world is near, they will show their true power and destroy the world in order to regenerate it. "
it: A vederlo è soltanto un cane shiba gigantesco, ma si dice che quando la fine del mondo si avvicina mostri la sua vera forza e distrugga il mondo per farlo rinascere.

jp: イェルス軍が開発した決戦兵器だったが、優秀すぎるＡＩが兵器として扱われることを拒み脱走。コストを抑え運用方法を見直した量産型が存在する。
jp_grezzo: "イェルス軍が開発した決戦兵器だったが、優秀すぎるＡＩが兵器として扱われることを拒み脱走。コストを抑え運用方法を見直した量産型が存在する。"
en: It was the decisive weapon developed by the Yerles Army, but its overly superior AI refused to be treated as a weapon and escaped. A mass-produced version exists, with reduced costs and revised operational methods.
en_grezzo: "It was the decisive weapon developed by the Yerles Army, but its overly superior AI refused to be treated as a weapon and escaped. A mass-produced version exists, with reduced costs and revised operational methods."
it: Era l'arma della battaglia decisiva sviluppata dall'esercito di Yerles, ma la sua intelligenza artificiale, fin troppo eccellente, si è rifiutata di essere trattata come un'arma ed è fuggita. Ne esiste un modello di serie, con i costi contenuti e l'impiego ripensato.

jp: かつてはエウダーナが誇る大魔導士であったが、人を捨て悪霊に魂を委ね転生した。人々の負の感情をエネルギーにする。
jp_grezzo: "かつてはエウダーナが誇る大魔導士であったが、人を捨て悪霊に魂を委ね転生した。人々の負の感情をエネルギーにする。"
en: He was once a great mage, the pride of Eulderna, but he abandoned people and gave his soul to evil spirits and was reincarnated. He uses people's negative emotions as energy.
en_grezzo: "He was once a great mage, the pride of Eulderna, but he abandoned people and gave his soul to evil spirits and was reincarnated. He uses people's negative emotions as energy."
it: Un tempo era il grande maestro dei maghi, il vanto di Eulderna, ma ha abbandonato la condizione umana, ha affidato l'anima agli spiriti maligni ed è rinato. Trae la sua energia dai sentimenti neri della gente.

jp: 召喚魔法を得意とする、騎士の称号を冠する魔法戦士。自らの魔力に絶対の自信を持っているため、非常に鼻持ちならない言動をする者が多い。
jp_grezzo: "召喚魔法を得意とする、騎士の称号を冠する魔法戦士。自らの魔力に絶対の自信を持っているため、非常に鼻持ちならない言動をする者が多い。"
en: A magic warrior with a knight's title who specialises in summoning magic. Because of their absolute confidence in their own magical power, many of them behave in a very snobbish manner.
en_grezzo: "A magic warrior with a knight's title who specialises in summoning magic. Because of their absolute confidence in their own magical power, many of them behave in a very snobbish manner."
it: Un guerriero magico che porta il titolo di cavaliere e che eccelle nella magia di evocazione. Della propria forza magica sono sicurissimi, e per questo in molti hanno modi che non si sopportano.

jp: 正気を失っているジューアの戦士。弱点である筋力を補おうと、薬物による強化を試みたところ、副作用によって破壊衝動が増幅されてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "正気を失っているジューアの戦士。弱点である筋力を補おうと、薬物による強化を試みたところ、副作用によって破壊衝動が増幅されてしまった。"
en: Jua warrior who has lost his sanity. In an attempt to compensate for his weak muscles, he tried to strengthen them with drugs, but the side effects amplified his destructive impulses.
en_grezzo: "Jua warrior who has lost his sanity. In an attempt to compensate for his weak muscles, he tried to strengthen them with drugs, but the side effects amplified his destructive impulses."
it: Un guerriero di Juere che ha perso il senno. Per rimediare al suo punto debole, la forza fisica, ha provato a potenziarsi con dei farmaci, e l'effetto collaterale gli ha amplificato l'impulso di distruggere.

jp: 自らの音楽センスに絶対的な自信を持つ。壊滅的に下手な演奏を聴かされた聴衆が死んでも、感激してショック死したと思い込むほど。
jp_grezzo: "自らの音楽センスに絶対的な自信を持つ。壊滅的に下手な演奏を聴かされた聴衆が死んでも、感激してショック死したと思い込むほど。"
en: She has absolute confidence in her own musical taste. Even when an audience member dies after hearing a devastatingly poor performance, she assumes that they died of shock because they were so impressed.
en_grezzo: "She has absolute confidence in her own musical taste. Even when an audience member dies after hearing a devastatingly poor performance, she assumes that they died of shock because they were so impressed."
it: Del proprio gusto musicale è sicura in modo assoluto. Se qualcuno del pubblico muore dopo aver sentito un'esecuzione rovinosa, lei si convince che sia morto per l'emozione, tanto ne era rimasto colpito.

jp: 母親が適当な教育をしていたため、常識に疎くアイテムの使い方もよく知らない。父親の狂乱ぶりに心を痛めており、よくわからないなりになんとかしようとしている。
jp_grezzo: "母親が適当な教育をしていたため、常識に疎くアイテムの使い方もよく知らない。父親の狂乱ぶりに心を痛めており、よくわからないなりになんとかしようとしている。"
en: Because of her mother's proper upbringing, he is not familiar with common sense and does not know how to use items well. He is heartbroken by his father's madness and tries to do something about it, even though he doesn't understand it well.
en_grezzo: "Because of her mother's proper upbringing, he is not familiar with common sense and does not know how to use items well. He is heartbroken by his father's madness and tries to do something about it, even though he doesn't understand it well."
it: La madre lo ha educato alla come viene, e così è digiuno di buon senso e non sa nemmeno bene come si usano gli oggetti. La follia del padre gli fa male al cuore, e pur senza capirci granché cerca in qualche modo di rimediare.

jp: 簡単な軍務をこなせるよう訓練されたプチ。戦闘力はイマイチだが数を簡単に揃えられるため、偵察・非常食・弾除け・特攻・地雷除去などに幅広く酷使されている。
jp_grezzo: "簡単な軍務をこなせるよう訓練されたプチ。戦闘力はイマイチだが数を簡単に揃えられるため、偵察・非常食・弾除け・特攻・地雷除去などに幅広く酷使されている。"
en: Putits trained to perform simple military tasks. They are not very good at fighting, but can be easily assembled in numbers and are widely used for reconnaissance, emergency rations, bullet repellent, suicide attacks, mine clearance, etc.
en_grezzo: "Putits trained to perform simple military tasks. They are not very good at fighting, but can be easily assembled in numbers and are widely used for reconnaissance, emergency rations, bullet repellent, suicide attacks, mine clearance, etc."
it: Putit addestrati a svolgere semplici mansioni militari. In combattimento valgono poco, ma è facile metterne insieme tanti, e così li sfruttano senza pietà per l'esplorazione, come razione d'emergenza, come parapalle, per gli assalti suicidi, per sminare e per altro ancora.

jp: あまりに無能なため警備部隊の隊長もとい全自動の警備システムの見張り、という役職につけられた。一応そのことに負い目を感じているがサボることはやめない。
jp_grezzo: "あまりに無能なため警備部隊の隊長もとい全自動の警備システムの見張り、という役職につけられた。一応そのことに負い目を感じているがサボることはやめない。"
en: Because he is so incompetent, he was given the position of head of the security force, a guard of the fully automated security system. He feels guilty about it, but he never stops slacking off.
en_grezzo: "Because he is so incompetent, he was given the position of head of the security force, a guard of the fully automated security system. He feels guilty about it, but he never stops slacking off."
it: Siccome è di un'incapacità totale, gli hanno affidato il posto di comandante del corpo di guardia, o meglio di sorvegliante del sistema di sicurezza tutto automatico. Un po' se ne sente in colpa, ma non per questo smette di battere la fiacca.

jp: 特殊部隊の隊長を務めるプロフェッショナル。任務に忠実で規律に厳しいがその分ストレスがたまっており、プチを横目でちらちら見ては密かに癒されている。
jp_grezzo: "特殊部隊の隊長を務めるプロフェッショナル。任務に忠実で規律に厳しいがその分ストレスがたまっており、プチを横目でちらちら見ては密かに癒されている。"
en: Professional special forces commander. She is faithful to her duties and strictly disciplined, but is stressed out because of this, and is secretly soothed by glancing at Putits with a sideways glance.
en_grezzo: "Professional special forces commander. She is faithful to her duties and strictly disciplined, but is stressed out because of this, and is secretly soothed by glancing at Putits with a sideways glance."
it: Una professionista che comanda le forze speciali. È fedele agli ordini e severa sulla disciplina, ma proprio per questo accumula tensione, e si consola di nascosto sbirciando i putit con la coda dell'occhio.

jp: 拳銃を所持しているが 、追い詰められなければ発砲しない。誰かが泣いていると困ってしまって一緒に泣いてしまう。軍用プチとは仲がよい。
jp_grezzo: "拳銃を所持しているが 、追い詰められなければ発砲しない。誰かが泣いていると困ってしまって一緒に泣いてしまう。軍用プチとは仲がよい。"
en: It carries a handgun but will not fire unless cornered. If someone is crying, it gets distressed and cries with them. Friend of the military putits.
en_grezzo: "It carries a handgun but will not fire unless cornered. If someone is crying, it gets distressed and cries with them. Friend of the military putits."
it: Porta con sé una pistola, ma non spara a meno che non lo mettano alle strette. Se qualcuno piange lui si mette in imbarazzo e finisce per piangere insieme a lui. Con i putit militari va d'accordo.

jp: 荒くれの海賊たちをまとめる存在。若いころは人一倍ロマンと情熱に燃える海の男だったが、生活のため略奪を繰り返すうちにいつしか初心を忘れてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "荒くれの海賊たちをまとめる存在。若いころは人一倍ロマンと情熱に燃える海の男だったが、生活のため略奪を繰り返すうちにいつしか初心を忘れてしまった。"
en: A leader of a band of rough-and-tumble pirates. In his youth, he was a man of the sea, burning with more romance and passion than any other man, but as he repeatedly plundered for a living, he somehow forgot his original intentions.
en_grezzo: "A leader of a band of rough-and-tumble pirates. In his youth, he was a man of the sea, burning with more romance and passion than any other man, but as he repeatedly plundered for a living, he somehow forgot his original intentions. "
it: È lui a tenere insieme i pirati più turbolenti. Da giovane era un uomo di mare che ardeva di romanticismo e di passione più di chiunque altro, ma a furia di saccheggiare per campare, un po' alla volta si è scordato come aveva cominciato.
